<DOCSTRING>
Initializes configuration and schedule directories.

Args:
    CONFIG_PATH (str): The path to the configuration directory. Must exist or will be created.
    SCHEDULES_PATH (str): The path to the schedules file. If it does not exist, it will be created with an empty array.

Returns:
    None: The function does not return a value but sets up the necessary directories and files for the application.
</DOCSTRING>
